renderContract.commonPrompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: premium work-strength shared-world guardian card master artwork, full-bleed 3:4. Show exactly the two named guardians or canonical internal pair from the approved source and no third guardian, coworker, manager, client, recipient, human, silhouette, reflection, body clue, empty seat or personal belonging implying another person. Preserve both canonical identities, relative size/colors, clothing, signature props, dark-purple eyes with exactly one large plus one small highlight in each visible eye, and visible chest Stella stars. The pair plus one shared work system covers 55–65% and remains readable at actual width 80px. Give each guardian one independent control, token or task boundary and keep a visible open handoff zone; never imply hierarchy, compulsory care, unanimous agreement, guaranteed mastery, flawless quality, promotion or predetermined success. Written work surfaces use isolated symbols and geometric reliefs only: no readable text, pseudo-text, handwriting lines, names, labels, score, number, date, clock, calendar grid, map coordinate, question mark, zodiac glyph, arrow route, logo or watermark. Do not bake actual birth-chart lines or personal colors into the master art. Every board, bridge, clip, band, lock, connector, box, tile, token, clamp or tag remains removable, half-set, open-ended, unlatched or still adjustable. Only Scorpio canonical tail-heart tip is allowed; no added heart or heart-shaped light/void. No closed ring, halo, portal, infinity sign, deterministic route or completed mastery emblem. Keep every composition distinct in pair axis, camera height, role boundary, focal-system silhouette and open negative-space shape. Follow compositionFamily, artDirection, distinctFrom and visualReviewFocus literally. Soft colored-pencil and watercolor, visible paper grain, rounded plush proportions and deep-purple outlines; no readable text, no logo, no watermark.
